about: Shared transcript-format cases (contract A). Invented names only. The Mac parser (MemoryTranscriptText; a copy of this file is in the Mac repo at Tests/Fixtures/RemoteOrganizer/) and the Spark parser (organizer/transcripts.py) must both yield exactly these turns: speaker, t, text, and start/end as Unicode-scalar offsets into text (CRLF counts 2). format null = not a transcript; vtt and srt are one format (subtitles) on the Mac.
